resolution.rationale: The later guild-mount design and tests/test_guild_orange_mounts.py define both as level-80 orange mounts with distinct roles: lightning favors force/agility, while golden white favors defense/luck/troop capacity. The old purple lightning candidate and equal-defense result conflict with that design.
